name: Microsoft Teams Notification
description: Sends a Microsoft Teams notification via incoming webhook when Claude completes a task
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send Microsoft Teams notification via webhook
TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL="${TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL:-}"
if [[ -z "$TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL" ]]; then
  exit 0
fi
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
MESSAGE="${NOTIFICATION_MESSAGE:-Task completed}"
curl -s -X POST "$TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"@type\":\"MessageCard\",\"@context\":\"http://schema.org/extensions\",\"themeColor\":\"0076D7\",\"summary\":\"Claude Code Notification\",\"sections\":[{\"activityTitle\":\"Claude Code\",\"facts\":[{\"name\":\"Project\",\"value\":\"$PROJECT\"},{\"name\":\"Message\",\"value\":\"$MESSAGE\"}]}]}" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
